description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.desc: Rams TE Colby Parkinson (ribs) is officially active for a Week 9 matchup with Washington.
items.impact: Parkinson was considered questionable to play after logging just one limited practice session. He will likely see plenty of snaps, with Tyler Higbee and Davis Allen also figuring to factor into the rotation at tight end.
items.title: Colby Parkinson (ribs) officially active for Week 9

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.desc: Cam Skattebo (hamstring) is officially inactive against the Eagles on Sunday.
items.impact: With Skattebo out and Tyrone Tracy on IR, Devin Singletary will lead the Giants backfield on Sunday. He should be viewed as an RB3 with RB2 upside.
items.title: Cam Skattebo (hamstring) inactive against Philadelphia

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.desc: Saints WR Jordyn Tyson (hamstring) is officially active for a Week 9 matchup with the Browns.
items.impact: Tyson was listed as questionable after being a limited participant in practice this week. Tyson is set to make his debut Sunday, but fantasy managers should not expect to much as the Saints will likely slowly work him into the lineup.
items.title: Jordyn Tyson (hamstring) officially active for Week 9

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.desc: Browns QB Deshaun Watson (concussion) is officially inactive for a Week 9 matchup with the Saints.
items.impact: Watson did not clear the concussion protocol in time to be active for Sunday's contest. Sheduer Sanders will draw the start, with Dillion Gabriel serving as the backup.
items.title: Deshaun Watson (concussion) officially inactive for Week 9

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.desc: Sione Vaki (ankle) is active for Week 9 for the Detroit Lions.
items.impact: Vaki is good to go after passing through pregame checks, as the running back will look to take advantage of a complementary role behind superstar No.1 running back Jahmyr Gibbs against the Dolphins Sunday.
items.title: Sione Vaki (ankle) active for Week 9

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.desc: Cowboys WR George Pickens (hamstring) is officially inactive for a Week 9 matchup with the Colts.
items.impact: Pickens was considered questionable to play this week. His absence will open up targets for Ryan Flournoy and Jake Ferguson against the Colts.
items.title: George Pickens (hamstring) officially inactive for Week 9

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.desc: Cowboys TE Jake Ferguson (ankle) is officially active for a Week 9 matchup with the Colts.
items.impact: Ferguson was considered questionable after being limited in practice to close out the week. He should be in line for additional targets with George Pickens (hamstring) inactive for Week 9.
items.title: Jake Ferguson (ankle) officially active for Week 9

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.desc: Cowboys TE Luke Schoonmaker (groin) is officially inactive for a Week 9 matchup with the Colts.
items.impact: Schoonmaker was considered questionable to play against the Colts as he continues to deal with a groin issue. Jake Ferguson and Brevyn Spann-Ford will see the bulk of the playing time at tight end for Dallas.
items.title: Luke Schoonmaker (groin) officially inactive for Week 9

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.desc: Amon-Ra St. Brown (ribs) is active for Week 9 for the Detroit Lions.
items.title: Amon-Ra St. Brown (ribs) active for Week 9

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.desc: Christian McCaffrey (hamstring) is expected to see his full workload Sunday according to Mike Garafolo.
items.impact: McCaffrey looks to not have any limitations entering Sunday's Week 9 matchup against the Las Vegas Raiders, offering head coach Kyle Shanahan one of his more dynamic playmakers as part of a San Francisco offense ravaged by injuries entering Sunday.
items.title: Christian McCaffrey (hamstring) expected to see full workload Sunday

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.desc: Emeka Egbuka (foot) will play in Sunday's matchup between night's matchup between the Tampa Bay Buccaneers and Chicago Bears according to Ian Rapoport.
items.impact: Egbuka progressed enough throughout the week after being limited to entering it, as the wideout looks to provide quarterback Baker Mayfield with an impactful pass-catching option against the Chicago Bears Sunday night.
items.title: Emeka Egbuka (foot) will play Sunday

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.desc: Kyle Monangai (thumb/toe) will not play in Sunday night's contest between the Chicago Bears and Tampa Bay Buccaneers according to Ian Rapoport.
items.impact: Monangai will remain sidelined once again, as the running back is expected to return in Week 11 according to Rapoport. Roschon Johnson should once again fill the No. 2 running back role behind starter D'Andre Swift against the Buccaneers for head coach Ben Johnson Sunday night.
items.title: Kyle Monangai (thumb/toe) will not play Sunday
